what: what the monitor counts as a warning and as an alert. Written by hand in slice 10, BEFORE the monitor was run on anything - this file is a declaration, not a fit.
reference: the 16,134 applications before 2016-01-01 that the model's weights were fitted on

psi.bins: 10 quantile bins cut on the reference; a feature with 10 or fewer distinct values gets one bin per value
psi.why_these: 0.10 and 0.25 are the usual industry rule of thumb. They are not tuned to this data.
psi.noise_rule: a PSI only counts if it is also above the 99th percentile of the PSI that random samples of the same size drawn from the reference give. A small window has a PSI above zero from sampling alone.

share_of_requests.note: written after slice 9 had already reported 2.9% outside the range over the whole test book, so these two numbers are not blind. They are round on purpose.

calibration_gap.rule: |mean predicted - observed bad rate|, and only if the observed rate is outside the 95% binomial interval around the prediction

auc.rule: warn when the quarter's 95% bootstrap interval lies entirely below the cross-validated training AUC from slice 4

retrain_review: two quarters in a row with an alert on the score PSI or on calibration. A review is a person looking, not an automatic retrain.
